summary: Correct independent review finding on aee8bdd: agent Run no longer waits for the member-only pool storage reconcile pass, which a hung remote mount could hold open and block agent stop, re-enrollment and service shutdown; masters never start that pass. The local handoff no longer cancels pending pool scope recovery when Run exits on its own. API impact: none.

guide.reason: Internal agent lifecycle correction; no operator workflow changes.

api.reason: API impact: none. No Controller, Core-local or peer contract changes; only agent goroutine lifecycle.

state.reason: No durable state added or changed.
